steps.content: The show's second act is about to commence.
The lights of the private box slowly came on, gilding the graceful lady with a dull aura. She listens to the melodies and voices, softly applauding.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Quite good, quite good. We're seamlessly moving into the second act.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Looks like almost all have found their desired part in this play.
Lady Pearl, resting on the edge of the box's window, gazes down at the crowd on the stage.
Looking around, her focus landed on the person in the grey coat among the people.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Oh!? There still seem to be a few lambs roaming about...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Hehe, there's no rush to it, dears...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Keep immersing, keep enjoying...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Life's about making choices. Every decision you make will lead you closer to the role that's just right for you... I'm looking forward to that moment...

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: That moment when you transform into what you've always dreamed of being...
She gazes at the performers on stage and the enthralled audience, a look of contentment spreading across her face.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Okay, dear audience, the second act is about to start.

steps.speaker: Lady Pearl
steps.content: Ready to keep enjoying the show?

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: Miss Luvia Ray, so you're going ahead with the press conference tonight?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: That's right! The moment the bell tolls five times, the press conference kicks off.

steps.speaker: Reporter
steps.content: This soon? Have you guys got your evidence and presentations all lined up?

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Our journey testifies to our struggles. We are the living embodiment of injustice!
Luvia Ray remains in front of her fellow escapees, addressing the press.

steps.speaker: Luvia Ray
steps.content: Everyone, please come and witness the moment we clear our names!
Draw the curtain back.
With that final line, the curtains draw to a close, and the audience begins to file out through the gaping hole left by the explosion, buzzing with excitement over the show.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Wow, that dance was awesome, and the singing was top-notch too!

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: Seeing it firsthand truly makes a difference!

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Got it, it's etched in my mind... The moment the bell tolls five times, that's when we prove our innocence!

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: Come on, let's move! We've got to catch up with that woman in charge. I'm not missing the next act!
Spectators begin streaming in the direction where Luvia Ray vanished, with a few glancing back to hurry you along.

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: Come on, hurry! If you stay, the guards might toss you back in there!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Uhhh, teaming up to follow that lady in charge is one thing, but acting... Sorry, that's really not my cup of tea.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I, I'm gonna have to say no as well.
Thinking back to when she was encircled and teased by those prisoner girls, Ignis edges behind you, gulping apprehensively.

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Shame, really. I mean, imagine being falsely accused, and then the rush of clearing your name—must be quite a thrill!

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: Totally, I just love seeing their faces—a mix of surprise and guilt!
The two spectators shrug and don't push it further, leading you all towards the curtain.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I thought... behind this curtain was just backstage...
Looking around, you see a T-shaped road cutting across the stage, flanked by buildings of different heights stretching into the background.
Drivers at the wheel lean out to tell you and Ignis to step aside, and right there on the street, a newsboy is continuously hawking his papers.

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: Mind your step, Miss!
A chef carrying a tray of oven-fresh bread walks by Ignis. The inviting scent of warm, buttery, sugared bread drifts under your nose.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Incredible... the set transformed instantly.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Just like a magician's trick...
You and Ignis can't help but express your awe as you stroll down the designated "walkway."

steps.speaker: Newsboy
steps.content: Exclusive Update! Exclusive Update!

steps.speaker: Newsboy
steps.content: Numerous prisoners have fled Fortuna Prison, but they claim they are innocent! Tonight, when the bell tolls five times, they'll host a press conference, to prove they've been framed!

steps.speaker: Newsboy
steps.content: Ladies and gents, care for a copy? It's the talk of the town today!
steps.female_content: Ladies, care for a copy? It's the talk of the town today!

steps.content: The newsboy glances at Ignis, then you catch Ignis's gaze. With a resigned sigh, you fish out a hundred DisCoins from your wallet.

steps.speaker: Newsboy
steps.content: Whoa, thanks, sir! Hope you have a fantastic day!
steps.female_content: Whoa, thanks, miss! Hope you have a fantastic day!

steps.content: The newsboy grabs the cash, hands over a copy of the paper, and moves along the street, calling out the day's news.

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: Sigh... What's going on with the world these days?

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: What... You don't believe these people are innocent?

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: I'd rather not comment.
The chef, busy with his bread, shakes his head dismissively. But then, he does a double-take between the paper and you guys.

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: Hold on!! Are you folks on the run from Fortuna? Get away from here, and fast! Or else I'm going to alert them, and they will catch you!

steps.speaker: Spectator A
steps.content: Yeah, we are, and what's it to you?!

steps.speaker: Spectator B
steps.content: We already said we were innocent. If you hand us over, you're just as guilty! You'll be the same as them!!
Suddenly, those two spectators kick up a fuss, acting as though they had become characters in the play.
The crowd on the street becomes hostile, looking as if they're ready to throw punches. Your only option is to grab Ignis and duck behind a stage prop.
Ignis hasn't said a word for some time now, enduring the unwarranted rejection and expulsion by the crowd. You feel the unease of the Sinner from the other side of the shackles.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Don't worry, it's all just part of the show.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's just that their act was a bit too lifelike... and quite unexpected...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I'm alright... no worries. It's just, I never thought I'd feel the sting of being chased off like this again.
Ignis gives a slight shake of her head and steps closer to you, letting out a sigh that seems to carry relief.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: The two performers have bolted. What's our next move? Where do we go from here?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: We've got to track down Luvia, right? We need to find the heroine to see the story progress.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: True, as spectators, the theater would want us to stay engaged in the performance. They won't make the clues too hard to find.
You take a quick glance outside, making sure the performers have lost interest in you and Ignis. Once clear, you guide Ignis away from the stage prop.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Come on, there are plenty of rooms to explore. Let's check them out; we're bound to find something.
